packagedSnapshot.mode: Existing --snapshot-small AppKit/SwiftUI command from the exact extracted package.

models.0: Gaussian centered at the bounding-box center, sigma as a fraction of nominal diameter
models.100: Radial Gaussian CDF feather of a nominal disk with fitted offset and constant standard deviation in pixels

roundBrushHoldoutModels.scope: Diagnostic models fitted only to 7, 12 and 21 px at either 0% or 100% hardness. The two models were evaluated on omitted sizes, including a separate reference document at 13 px. Main-sheet distances use the recorded click minus one pixel on each axis. The separate sheet uses each stamp bounding-box center. No proprietary implementation or preset payload was examined.

roundBrushSupport.argument: A circle of radius R cannot contain a pair farther apart than 2R. Photato currently returns zero at and beyond the nominal round radius plus half a pixel. Positive exported samples that reach or exceed that circle diameter contradict a fixed native support circle for any center.
roundBrushSupport.scope: A geometric support check on publicly observable alpha exported from two earlier owned Photoshop documents. The proof does not require the exact mouse-to-canvas transform.
